verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe generating full-stack apps in one flow: 'Quickly scaffold full-stack apps or components' (v0-docs-15), 'Connect to backend to build rich, data driven applications' (v0-docs-24), and 'v0 plans, creates tasks, and connects to databases as it builds' (v0-docs-35), with integrations to Supabase/Neon/Upstash (v0-docs-28). Community evidence (v0-comm-1) confirms a real internal app with auth/roles/export was built from v0, suggesting backend logic generation works in practice, but most corroboration focuses on UI quality rather than backend logic specifically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of backend/API logic generation quality, and clearer first-party documentation of how server-side code (not just DB connections) is produced from a single prompt.
